Source: spe/predictions/r02.yaml (saved before the run) and spe/evals/results/r02/r02.json.
The run used 40 tickets with 5 trials per cell.

The r02.yaml file has two gaps. It stated no error bands. It also used the key `pass_rates`, and no grader emits that key. This log reads `pass_rates` as `category_acc`. For the verdicts, this log uses a band of ±0.03 for accuracy and ±25% for cost. That band was picked after the results came in, so the verdicts are soft. See F5.

| Metric | Config | Predicted | Measured | Same as last round | Verdict | Closer |

| category_acc | A | 0.85 | 0.86 | 0.84 | hit (+0.01) | prediction |
| category_acc | B | 0.88 | 0.86 | 0.84 | hit (-0.02) | tie (both off by 0.02) |

| category_acc | D | 0.75 | 0.74 | 0.70 | hit (-0.01) | prediction |
| priority_acc | C | 0.80 | 0.71 | not stated | miss (-0.09) | n/a |
| cost_per_ticket | D | $0.002 | $0.004 | not stated | miss (2x) | n/a |

Measured but not predicted:

| Config | priority_acc | cost per ticket | tool_calls |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 0.79 | $0.011 | 4.1 |
| B | 0.78 | $0.009 | 4.0 |
| C | 0.71 | $0.007 | 2.6 |

### Which Why broke

- **C: "merged tools cut wrong tool choice."** Tool calls fell from 4.1 to 2.6. The cut removed calls C needed. C never called check_status on 9 outage tickets. The broken assumption is that fewer tools means fewer wrong choices. With fewer tools, C skipped a needed call. That cost 0.06 category accuracy against A and 0.08 priority accuracy. See F3.
- **D cost: "same design on a smaller model."** This Why covered accuracy only. It said nothing about cost. The $0.002 figure assumed the same token use as A at a lower price. D retried on tickets over 2,000 words, and those retries doubled its tokens. See F4.
- **B: "shorter prompt keeps focus."** The number hit, but the Why has no support. B matched A on category_acc at 0.86. B was lower on priority_acc (0.78 against 0.79). The shorter prompt saved cost ($0.009 against $0.011). It did not improve accuracy.
- **D accuracy: "loses about 0.15."** D lost 0.12 on category and 0.13 on priority against A. This Why held within the band.

### Noise note

The ticket is the unit that matters. 40 tickets give a standard error of about 0.06 at 0.80 accuracy. That is wider than the ±0.03 band used above. The 0.00 gap between A and B is inside the noise. The 0.10 miss on C is outside it.
